alex_sales: Heads up 0: fintech prospect wants a quick POC this week: browser demo using our JS SDK, streaming responses (SSE preferred) + function/tool calls that emit structured JSON events. They report intermittent 403 mid-stream when tokens rotate. Any quick unblock?

mira_se: Short checklist: token type (ephemeral vs long-lived), transport (SSE vs websocket), CORS config, and whether the client handles reconnects on token expiry.

alex_sales: They use ephemeral demo tokens + SSE fallback in browser.

kai_engineer: Browser+SSE+ephemeral = common failure. SSE doesn't do in-band reconnects; when token TTL passes the server will reject new frames. Recommend websocket SDK or a tiny token-proxy that mints fresh ephemeral tokens and triggers reconnects.

ops_jen: Also verify Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Allow-Credentials if using cookies. If demo spikes QPS, request burst quota for the trial to avoid 429s.

alex_sales: Are tool calls streamed as separate events? They want a tool result event per call.

mira_se: Yes 0: we emit discrete events (tool_call_start/tool_call_result) as JSON lines over SSE or ws. Client should parse per-event. Our JS SDK exposes onTool callback to normalize it.

kai_engineer: If they need a final consolidated JSON, we can emit a `final` event, but per-event is lower-latency.

alex_sales: Pricing and security asks: does streaming cost more? token billing for tool calls? SOC2, BYOK, SAML, IP allowlist?

ops_jen: Billing: streamed and non-streamed are billed per-token the same. Tool calls: model tokens billed; external API calls not billed by us. SOC2 pack available. BYOK/KMS supported on Dedicated/Private; hosted BYOK requires support ticket and region eligibility. SAML and IP allowlist are enterprise features.

kai_engineer: Blockers to flag: missing reconnect flow for ephemeral tokens, CORS misconfig, BYOK not ready for hosted quick-demo, on-prem needs Private deployment.

alex_sales: Short-term plan to unblock demo this week?

kai_engineer: 1) Use websocket SDK for demo. 2) Add tiny token-proxy (lambda) to mint fresh tokens and force reconnect when TTL < 30s. 3) Use onTool callback to parse events. Escalate BYOK separately if required.

mira_se: I'll prepare a minimal client snippet and handoff notes.

ops_jen: I'll request burst quota and draft security questionnaire answers for SOC2/BYOK/SAML/IP allowlist.

alex_sales: Can someone join the customer call Thursday 10am PST and own the demo?

kai_engineer: I'll join and own SDK.

mira_se: I'll be there for token flow and sample proxy.

icket-bot: New ticket #SUP-4902 created for ephemeral token rotation sample. Assigned: mira_se, kai_engineer.

alex_sales: Thanks all 0: pre-demo run Wednesday 2pm PT. Leaving pricing ask for AE: estimate for ~1M tokens/month streaming + 2-GPU Dedicated trial. Ping here if blocked.
